Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Source: `src/` (`src/cli`, `src/commands`, `src/provider-web.ts`, `src/infra`, `src/media`); tests `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; plugins `extensions/*`. Keep plugin-only deps in the extension `package.json`; do not add them to the root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers `https://clawd.bot/*` are in sibling repo `../clawd.bot`: `public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`.

Always consider **all** built-in + extension channels when refactoring shared logic (routing, allowlists, pairing, command gating, onboarding, docs). Core: `docs/channels/`, `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; extensions: `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Docs use Mintlify (docs.clawd.bot). Links in `docs/**/*.md`: root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; cross-references use anchors. When Peter asks for links, reply with full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. When you touch docs, end the reply with the `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs you referenced. README links stay absolute. Docs content must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Node **22+**; keep Node + Bun paths working. Install: `pnpm install`; supported: `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun for TypeScript execution: `bun <file.ts>` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev CLI: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`; Node supports `dist/*` and production installs. Build/type-check: `pnpm build`; lint: `pnpm lint`; format: `pnpm format`; tests: `pnpm test`; coverage: `pnpm test:coverage`. Run `pnpm lint` before commits. Run `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing when you touch logic. Live: `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live` or `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`; Docker: `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`; onboarding: `pnpm test:docker:onboard`. Details: `docs/testing.md`. Vitest/V8 thresholds: 70% lines/branches/functions/statements; tests `*.test.ts`, e2e `*.e2e.test.ts`.

TypeScript ESM; prefer strict typing, avoid `any`. Add brief comments for tricky logic. Keep files concise; extract helpers instead of “V2” copies; use existing CLI option patterns and dependency injection via `createDefaultDeps`. Aim under ~700 LOC (or ~500 LOC when feasible); split/refactor when useful. Pure test additions/fixes generally do **not** need a changelog entry unless they alter user-facing behavior or the user asks for one.

Product/app/docs headings: **Clawdbot**; CLI, package/binary, paths/config keys: `clawdbot`. Changelog: latest released version at top, no `Unreleased`; after publishing, bump version and start a new top section. PRs summarize scope, testing, user-facing changes/new flags.

Mobile: before using a simulator, check for connected real devices (iOS + Android) and prefer them when available. Before testing, verify connected real devices before reaching for simulators/emulators. “restart iOS/Android apps” means rebuild (recompile/install) and relaunch, not just kill/launch.

Create commits with `scripts/committer "<msg>" <file...>`; avoid manual `git add`/`git commit` so staging stays scoped. Use concise, action-oriented commit messages; group related changes, avoid unrelated refactors.
